author: Hoon Kim
title: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator
content:
Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator
We'll provide character design concepts. You'll create high-quality, commercial-use illustrations with poses and backgrounds.
Quality level matching the attached characters
Requirements:
- Japanese anime art style (see attached images)
- Experience with 2D game character art
- Faithful to the original design (hair, outfit, colors)
To apply: Send your portfolio.
Feel free to reach out!

author: Abbie Cornall
title: Hiring Colorist and Procreate Illustrator
content:
A VERY EXCITING day today! It's RECRUITMENT DAY!
I am looking to HIRE two positions - please message me in the DMs if you are interested!
1) A COLORIST: create mobile phone video recordings of coloring in Viva Chroma Coloring Pages.
2) A PROCREATE ILLUSTRATOR: hand finish coloring page designs using Procreate. Simple bold designs that will grow in complexity. Provide all pages; add hand-drawn finesse.
Work starts small and grows. Prefer people with disadvantages in workplace. Send DM with example of work and proposed fee per video and per 5 pages. Contact: DM on Facebook.
